beaches.name: Italida (Platia Pounta)
beaches.summary: Nude bathing concentrates at the eastern end, away from the village. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2000 to September 2024; an August 2025 Greek travel listicle names the adjacent Mikri Italida cove. Midsummer crowds reduce nude use to the eastern corner.

beaches.name: Nero (Kato Koufonisi)
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported at the southern end, reached by boat from Ano Koufonisi. A naturist directory carries reports from 2004 to June 2024; a July 2022 visit found the beach half nude. Port police checked campers in 2007 but showed no interest in naturists.

beaches.name: Pori
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported at the southern end; recent reports conflict. A naturist directory carries reports from 1996 to September 2024: June 2023 and June 2024 visits found the beach fully clothed, while a September 2024 visit found the southern end half nude.
